Joins Montgomery tracts with 2025 code violation counts and CDC high blood pressure prevalence, computes the violation rate per 1,000 residents, and returns the correlation and paired tract count across all tracts ordered by the violation rate.
sql: WITH code_counts AS (SELECT geoid, n AS code_violation_count FROM fw_pg.tract_counts WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_effb1d' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'), cdc_data AS (SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation, CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence FROM session.fw_effb1d_m2_cdc WHERE bphigh_crudeprev IS NOT NULL), tract_measures AS (SELECT tr.geoid, tr.name, COALESCE(cc.code_violation_count, 0) AS code_violation_count, cd.totalpopulation, CAST(COALESCE(cc.code_violation_count, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(cd.totalpopulation, 0) * 1000.0 AS code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, cd.adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence FROM fw_pg.tracts tr LEFT JOIN code_counts cc ON tr.geoid = cc.geoid LEFT JOIN cdc_data cd ON tr.geoid = cd.geoid) SELECT name, code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, code_violation_count, totalpopulation, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence, CORR(code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents, adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence) OVER () AS corr_code_violation_rate_to_high_blood_pressure, COUNT(CASE WHEN code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents IS NOT NULL AND adult_high_blood_pressure_prevalence IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) OVER () AS paired_tracts, geoid FROM tract_measures ORDER BY code_violation_rate_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC LIMIT 200
